Delete a folder; INBOX and role folders are refused (disabled unless policy allows it)

## Usage

```text
chainmail folder delete <name> --account <account> [--force] [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail folder delete Old --account work
# also delete the mail in it
chainmail folder delete Old --account work --force
```

## Flags

```text
      --force   delete the folder even when it holds mail, and the mail with it (on Google the messages stay in All Mail)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --account string   the account the folder is on (required)
      --output string    output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string    daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
